rounds.notes:
As a WP build, [Medimaster](item_a04e1041-01c1-46ed-801e-d0590003e9b6) is the best Round 1 choice we have.

Greens should be [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0),  [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf), and your 1500 of choice.

round_upgrades.notes: Medimaster is the base for this build as it increases your primary heal.

rounds.notes:
For Round 2 if you earned enough cash you'll want both [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) and [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) to boost your heals, but if you don't have enough cash, [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) is the pivotal purchase.

If you don't get [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a), make sure you keep [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0). Fill in skills with [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) and your 1500 pick from Round 1.

round_upgrades.notes: Medimaster is the base for this build as it increases your primary heal.

rounds.notes:
Round 3 selections depend on how you and your team are doing.

The suggested build assumes you have earned $21000 and gives you a good boost to healing, but play with this as needed. 

For the power:
If team is dying too fast, select [Medicinal Missiles](item_30eeab6c-4a1e-4a16-b9dd-e83d633caa40) - even though it's a torpedo power and this is a WP build, hitting your allies with torpedoes before using Mediblaster will give an immediate 50% boost to received heals for 3s. Depending on your playstyle this may be a better Round 3 choice regardless, since the point with this build is to max your Mediblaster heals.

If they're doing fine and you don't feel like you need to boost your heals, or if you just really really want to kill some bads, you can make the rounds go faster with more damage by selecting [Stinger](item_e9d0d530-d620-4e74-a34d-38cdebfeb9a4) here.

For the epic(s):
You should be able to afford one of [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) or [Long Range Blaster](item_9dfc20e8-9a7b-4576-bdca-d75ada1b369b).

Take [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) IF:
- Your team is getting burned down fast

Take [Long Range Blaster](item_9dfc20e8-9a7b-4576-bdca-d75ada1b369b) IF:
- You're confident staying farther from your team AND
- The opposing team doesn't rely heavily on flankers

The default build here uses [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) because it gives the same WP% as [Long Range Blaster](item_9dfc20e8-9a7b-4576-bdca-d75ada1b369b) and assumes the other team probably has a Reaper or Genji targeting you.

If you are somehow super rich, you can either go ham on WP with Amari's + Long Range (23k + your other skills) or select one of those two and add a cheaper epic like   [Overdrive Core](item_a2a8dba1-5f2f-4da1-9445-b08f49162121) (10k) or [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) (10k). Overdrive Core is better if you're taking a ton of damage yourself.

You can also take [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) if you are getting burned down fast, but Overdrive Core looks like it's working better in this build. YMMV.



For the rare(s):
Keep [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e).
Keep [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a).
Purchase [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054).

For the common(s):
Prioritize [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) or [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf), and add whatever else you need to fill.

round_upgrades.notes: Medimaster is the base for this build as it increases your primary heal.

rounds.notes:
EDIT 7/23:
Wow, so in testing, attack speed is just as critical as WP for this build. Shoot fast heal much. See suggested tweaks:

- Where I suggested Amari's + either Long Range or Nebula, try *either* [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) OR [Long Range Blaster](item_9dfc20e8-9a7b-4576-bdca-d75ada1b369b) WITH [Commander's Clip](item_ff7cad01-2065-4908-a2c1-3bdf1458c7a4).

This gives more speed, more ammo, and ammo restore when you torpedo.

- Keep [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) and  [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054). If you can only afford 1 because you bought 2 epics, go with  [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e).

- Add [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) or [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) to round out.


PREVIOUS:

Ok, you made it to Round 4. At this point you should have enough credits to reasonably take at least two epics, so we will prioritize WP unless you're dying super fast.

 [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124)
 [Long Range Blaster](item_9dfc20e8-9a7b-4576-bdca-d75ada1b369b)

If you ARE dying super fast, pick one of those and add [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) instead.


Add to that:
 [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) 
 [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) 
Optionally [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a)

*Note the example build is prioritizing move speed with [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054). Faster Mediblaster hits + faster movement = more heals. If you have a Lucio with you or another speed boost option like JQ, you can instead prioritize WP with [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) as your second rare since Adv Nano gives attack speed after healing an ally.


Add your 1500 green. For the 6th slot, either take [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) or, if you can afford it, [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a).

round_upgrades.notes: Medimaster is the base for this build as it increases your primary heal.

rounds.notes:
Round 5! This is where the chosen skill combos get more interesting.

Power:
IF you took [Medicinal Missiles](item_30eeab6c-4a1e-4a16-b9dd-e83d633caa40) in Round 3 as in the example, your options are going to be:

- [Stinger](item_e9d0d530-d620-4e74-a34d-38cdebfeb9a4) if you're finding that you can spare attention to help DPS mow down some bads, OR

- [Stellar Focus](item_25bc8bc7-d147-4759-b8ff-5be20f14633a) because the tweak to this skill means much more potential healing and boosting during your ult. This is preferred for the example build, since the example build assumes you are hovering near your team and they'll be able to take advantage of it.

IF you took [Stinger](item_e9d0d530-d620-4e74-a34d-38cdebfeb9a4) in Round 3, now is the time to get [Medicinal Missiles](item_30eeab6c-4a1e-4a16-b9dd-e83d633caa40). No other choice will give as much boost to healing.


Epics:
Your epics should be [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) PLUS:

- IF you took [Stellar Focus](item_25bc8bc7-d147-4759-b8ff-5be20f14633a), [Sunburst Serum](item_a24151e7-1172-409e-a874-30f949006bfa) is a must have. 

** NOTE:** [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) looks tempting, but it only gives extra healing (+25 weapon damage/healing) *once* after you hit your ability, so don't bother with it.

Regardless of Stellar Focus, take at least one of:

-- [Long Range Blaster](item_9dfc20e8-9a7b-4576-bdca-d75ada1b369b) if you've got flankers on your team, OR

-- [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448) which starts at 10% instead of 15% but has stacking WP, OR

-- [Commander's Clip](item_ff7cad01-2065-4908-a2c1-3bdf1458c7a4) if you want to ditch  [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) and can afford the difference.


Rares:
Take/keep:
[Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) 
[Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) unless you have [Booster Jets](item_a291de85-b6d9-43cf-b5da-f3184a156f48) 
[Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) 

OPTIONAL: if you're doing enough damage on and off, [Technoleech](item_cb7fd8bf-bdcc-439a-ad35-372f24a027a8) is a nice option.

OPTIONAL: if you just have credits to spare, [Pulse Spike](item_6557a6d1-9c94-4635-9619-67257e26683e) or [Gravitational Push](item_2df314f2-c983-4984-bb08-070f93add5e1) are decent options, but Pulse Spike's reliance on torpedoes makes it less beneficial to us than if we had selected more of the Pulsar powers, and Gravitational is better suited to a Glide build.


Fill in with your favorite extras. Prioritize WP and speed (move/attack).

*Why not [Vantage Shot](item_6d7a0598-07cf-45ea-bbf5-c7e7b975e07a)??*

...because you're not prioritizing Glide and flight. 

*I'm dying too much!*

...swap in [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8).

round_upgrades.notes: Only take if you selected Stellar Focus as your power. Otherwise use Booster Jets or Commander's Clip.

**NOTE actual round cost with 4 epics is closer to 44k-50k.**

EDIT 7/23: some experimentation has led me to realize that taking [Stinger](item_e9d0d530-d620-4e74-a34d-38cdebfeb9a4) helps a lot with body count, and *Killer Juno* is totally doable with a WP build, but taking it means you will have to sacrifice either the boost from [Medicinal Missiles](item_30eeab6c-4a1e-4a16-b9dd-e83d633caa40) OR the HyperOrbitalHyperHeal described below.

HyperOrbitalHyperHeal is AP based, so my preference at the moment is to keep  [Medicinal Missiles](item_30eeab6c-4a1e-4a16-b9dd-e83d633caa40) and [Stinger](item_e9d0d530-d620-4e74-a34d-38cdebfeb9a4) 

That makes the suggested order:

R1 [Medimaster](item_a04e1041-01c1-46ed-801e-d0590003e9b6) 
R3 [Medicinal Missiles](item_30eeab6c-4a1e-4a16-b9dd-e83d633caa40) IF your heals need boosting, [Stinger](item_e9d0d530-d620-4e74-a34d-38cdebfeb9a4) if enemies aren't dying fast enough
R5 [Stellar Focus](item_25bc8bc7-d147-4759-b8ff-5be20f14633a) IF your team needs longer heals and damage boosting AND you're comfortable standing near them - otherwise whichever power you didn't take in R3
R7 whichever of the above are left


*If you choose to sacrifice the Medicinal Missiles boost to your primary fire heals, the suggested order for powers is going to shift somewhat - probably to this order:*

R1 [Medimaster](item_a04e1041-01c1-46ed-801e-d0590003e9b6) 
R3 [Stinger]
R5 [Stellar Focus](item_25bc8bc7-d147-4759-b8ff-5be20f14633a)
R7 [Hyper Healer](item_108336b3-54d2-4d69-8ea4-c2da5affb7ca)

PREVIOUS:
Your last power is one of:

- [Stellar Focus](item_25bc8bc7-d147-4759-b8ff-5be20f14633a) - MANDATORY if you didn't already take it because the tweak to this skill means much more potential healing and boosting during your ult, OR

- [Stinger](item_e9d0d530-d620-4e74-a34d-38cdebfeb9a4) if you didn't already take it and you're finding that you can spare attention to help DPS mow down some bads, OR

- [Hyper Healer](item_108336b3-54d2-4d69-8ea4-c2da5affb7ca) for a fun way to add a bunch of situational heals; you can tweak your other skills to get more benefit from this (see below).


If you DON'T take [Hyper Healer] and you have enough credits, take [Codebreaker](item_caa96c7e-655f-4d03-9bd9-0f41937fec27) to shoot at armored opponents or  [The Closer](item_173c6d0f-dbe6-440e-924f-0ce08189ddce) for +20% WP.

-- NOTE if you don't have enough creds for 4 epics you can swap in [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) --


**HYPER HEALER OPTION**
IF you want to go Hyper Ring healmaster, you'll have to play your cooldowns wisely: throw Hyper Ring just before your ult, use Orbital Ray, then have another Hyper Ring ready when OR wears off = your team has many hit points.

[Red Promise Regenerator](item_6a273bc5-41cc-4e81-b96b-ec373016518e) is NECESSARY for the Hyper Healer build because it gives you Hyper Ring-Orbital Ray-Hyper Ring capability. With Hyper Healer, your allies get 75 overhealth; Orbital Ray is prolonged thanks to Stellar Focus and gives 25% bonus to healing from Sunburst Serum, and it follows you (so you can stay by your team who just got overhealth but is about to plunge into a fight) AND it resets your Hyper Ring cooldown; throwing a follow-up Hyper Ring means your allies get more overhealth if the fight is still going.

Hyper Healer power means you might also want to take [Lux Loop](item_afa69bd2-683f-486d-bc1e-e40d49281679) for duration and [Solar Shielding](item_804fd8cd-78bd-46ee-a89f-20a6c9cccdcc) for +to your Orbital Ray and +ticking shield regen when your team goes through Hyper Ring.
